That's good, but I need us to use that window. Can you help me line up the commit history diffs between my sandbox branch and Tariq's PR before the meeting?

Yes. I’ll need your sandbox branch name and either repository access through an uploaded export or the command output. For a fast, read-only comparison against PR #418, run this from the repo:

```bash
git fetch origin --prune
git fetch origin pull/418/head:refs/remotes/origin/pr-418

SANDBOX="your-sandbox-branch"
PR="origin/pr-418"
BASE="$(git merge-base "$SANDBOX" "$PR")"

echo "=== COMMON BASE ==="
git show -s --format='%H %ad %an — %s' --date=iso "$BASE"

echo "=== UNIQUE COMMITS, SIDE BY SIDE ==="
git log --left-right --graph --cherry-pick \
  --format='%m %h %ad %an — %s' --date=short \
  "$SANDBOX...$PR"

echo "=== COMMIT-BY-COMMIT RANGE DIFF ==="
git range-diff "$BASE..$SANDBOX" "$BASE..$PR"

echo "=== FILE-LEVEL DIFFERENCES ==="
git diff --stat "$SANDBOX...$PR"
git diff --name-status "$SANDBOX...$PR"
```

Save everything for review:

```bash
{
  git show -s --format='%H %ad %an — %s' --date=iso "$BASE"
  git log --left-right --graph --cherry-pick \
    --format='%m %h %ad %an — %s' --date=short \
    "$SANDBOX...$PR"
  git range-diff "$BASE..$SANDBOX" "$BASE..$PR"
  git diff --stat "$SANDBOX...$PR"
  git diff --name-status "$SANDBOX...$PR"
} > /tmp/pr418-comparison.txt 2>&1
```

Upload or paste `/tmp/pr418-comparison.txt`, and I can turn it into a meeting-ready table showing:

- equivalent or duplicated commits  
- sandbox-only versus PR-only changes  
- commits rewritten or reordered  
- overlapping files and substantive code differences  
- items requiring clarification  

This is read-only: it won’t check out, merge, reset, or modify either branch.
